boilerplate: SNYPD is a Vinted monitor from Belgium that checks your Vinted searches about every 30 seconds and sends a push alert when a new matching listing appears; it never logs in to your Vinted account and never buys for you.
note: Every claim is on outreach/00-fact-sheet.md: about every 30 s = measured median (check-interval.json); push alerts; never logs in; no autobuy. gen_regions.py writes it into the Organization JSON-LD of index.html.
